approvalScope: Independent security/privacy review of frozen implementation, deterministic controls, live-smoke instrumentation and evidence verifier. This is not approval of ADR-006 acceptance or certification that hosted CI or actual provider smoke has passed.

findings.finding: Global consent could authorize another room/request.
findings.resolution: Non-serializable one-shot Permit binds generation, exact input digest, host cancellation ticket, room, request and unique invocation owner; spent permits cannot replay.

findings.finding: Provider changes could miss an unpublished Session and leave stale preview/apply authority.
findings.resolution: Atomic controller construction/publication under shared slot mutex; generation validation for prepare and approval; transaction lock orders configure against accepted Session.approve.

findings.finding: Malformed optional live configuration could prevent offline startup/restoration.
findings.resolution: Invalid optional budget/model/mock mode disables live selection without disabling offline host. Genuine Qt regression covers invalid configuration and cold restore.
retests: Static host.rs inspection; process_cases.py coverage independently reviewed; actual Qt execution delegated to integration reviewer/full chain

findings.finding: Oversized transient responses could bypass byte validation through retry.
findings.resolution: Byte cap checked before retry; both oversized 429 and 503 return BUDGET_EXCEEDED with exactly one attempt.

findings.finding: Downloaded evidence needed exact source inventory/Git-object binding, reviewer roles and review ancestry.
findings.resolution: Verifier binds exact committed source names/hashes, archive bytes, role and implementation commit ancestry; collector requires exact source map.

findings.finding: Same-room concurrency needed isolation from the global cap in its regression.
findings.resolution: Duplicate room request is polled immediately after first request, before filling global cap. Separate fifth-room cap and cancellation/audit isolation tests retained.

findings.finding: Caching remote audit identity with a constructor that rereads mutable configuration introduced a switch-to-offline construction failure that could propagate fatally; supplemental observations could also mislabel the old adapter as offline.
findings.resolution: Host factory passes immutable configured kind to for_kind without rereading mutable Control. Direct new remains strict; request checks reject mismatched kind/profile and all stale permit/generation work before key loading. Core and supplemental observations use immutable provider kind/model. Public README documents construction invariant.
retests: llm_020_single_use_room_and_switch_fences: captured remote selection then switch offline, for_kind construction succeeds, no key/transport call, offline fixture still works; mismatched immutable/current remote kind returns NOT_CONFIGURED.
openrouter_same_permit_and_canonical_provider_boundary: OpenRouter identity remains remote after offline reconfiguration.

securityAssessment.destination: Two separately allowlisted host-selected HTTPS origins: api.openai.com Responses or openrouter.ai Chat Completions; enum selects fixed origin/path, public DNS pinning and TLS/SNI verification remain mandatory, no arbitrary endpoint/proxy/redirect.
securityAssessment.credentials: Host-only lazy private-file or provider-specific environment source; no automatic OpenAI environment key use for OpenRouter. Private stdin transport, cleared helper environment, no shell/secret argv and existing file checks retained.
securityAssessment.bounds: Strict request/suggestion parsing, minimized catalog, no tools, byte/token/catalog/call/concurrency/deadline bounds, subprocess kill/reap and late-result fences.
securityAssessment.ui: Untrusted text rendered as plain text; existing proposal-bound approval remains required. Live-only driver waits for fresh actual proposal-digest decision; --consented flag does not independently establish human consent.
securityAssessment.limitations: Client cancellation cannot unsend admitted requests, guarantee server inference cancellation or stop billing. Rust/Python/OS copies are not claimed cryptographically erased. Topology apply and typed ingress remain separate accepted operations.

historicalApproval.note: Previous OpenAI-only review retained in Git history; current receipt reexecutes tests and refreshes hashes for separate OpenRouter delta.

openRouterDeltaReview.reviewed: Separate host enum profile and credential environment source, allowlisted private-frame origin selection, Chat response normalization, one-shot permit/canonical validator preservation, NVIDIA-only no-fallback zero-price routing filters, explicit logging/schema disclosure and live helper.
openRouterDeltaReview.schemaInterpretation: ADR-006 §2.3 prefers the selected provider facility when available and explicitly states provider shape is not a security boundary. Official capability verification is documented; this profile claims no provider schema enforcement and retains strict local parsing/value/membership checks. No acceptance criterion is weakened.
openRouterDeltaReview.credentialSeparation: HostCredential::OpenRouterEnvironment reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY only; OpenAI reads OPENAI_API_KEY only. WB_LLM_SECRET_FILE remains an explicit trusted host override; no inferred key reuse. Reviewer did not inspect either real file.
openRouterDeltaReview.privacy: data_collection:allow is explicit; UI discloses NVIDIA logging for security/product improvement, no ZDR claim. User remote-data consent is separate from proposal approval.
openRouterDeltaReview.routingLimit: Only nvidia, no fallbacks, fixed exact requested model and max_price zero filters; these express routing policy, not independently measured billing or proof of server compliance. Response provider drift is rejected when provider metadata is present.
openRouterDeltaReview.tests: 29 Rust cases (2 unit + 27 conformance), 5 no-socket transport tests, 2 metadata tests and exact committed source inventory binding passed.

approvalHistory.note: Previous OpenAI-only review retained in Git history; current receipt reexecutes tests and refreshes hashes for separate OpenRouter delta.
Previous separate OpenRouter review; actual successful live evidence remains honestly bound to this antecedent commit.

finalCancellationAuditReview.scope: Stable construction-time adapter identity, nonfatal provider-switch construction, fail-closed profile mismatch and supplemental audit identity.
finalCancellationAuditReview.liveCompatibilityAssessment: Reviewed delta affects construction under concurrent reconfiguration, mismatch rejection and cancellation/audit identity. Normal successful same-profile API request, strict parsing, actual proposal approval and accepted runtime path are unchanged. No actual live request on this final source is claimed.
